Stocks surged during the last week of April despite mixed reactions to the latest batch of Magnificent Seven earnings. **Stocks** The S&P 500 edged higher on Monday, reaching a new all-time high of 7,173.91 despite continued uncertainty regarding the conflict in Iran. On Wednesday, the S&P 500 was little changed following the latest FOMC meeting, which resulted in a decision to hold interest rates steady. Strong earnings reports from the tech and construction sectors lifted sentiment, pushing the S&P 500 1.02% higher. After the Fed announced its decision to hold rates steady on Wednesday, the 10-year yield jumped, climbing more than 5 basis points to 4.41%. **Oil** Oil prices climbed early in the week amidst new developments regarding the conflict in Iran. Nevertheless, prices pulled back on Friday following new developments regarding the conflict in Iran.
